description: AYM Syntex Limited manufactures and sells polyester filament yarn, nylon filament, and bulk continuous filament yarns for the textile and floor-covering industries in India, Australia, the European Union, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. The company also offers sewing threads and industrial yarns. Its products are used in various applications, including residential wall-to-wall, outdoor mats, home textiles, bath mats, sewing thread apparel and fashion solutions, automotive floor automotive interiors covering, contract/hospitality, outdoor, and handmade carpets; rugs, bathmats, and carpet tiles; automotive products; fashion and apparel, sarees and dress materials, and hosiery and socks; sweaters; nylon industrial yarns; residential wallto-wall carpets; polyster industrial yarns; home and medical textiles; sportswear; narrow fabrics; and sportswear. The company sells its products under the Comfeel, Elior, Polycycle, Arcticool, Spinovate, Silque, Ultraflex, Assura, Sorenyl, Rezilia, Ecose, Silkenza, Greenova, Polymagic, Sparkle, Wonderfeel, Polywonder, Synergy, and Opulenz brand names. In addition, the company provides applications, including residential and commercial flooring, automotive, industrial, technical textiles, apparel, home furnishings, and other end-use sectors. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Welspun Syntex Limited and changed its name to AYM Syntex Limited in December 2015. AYM Syntex Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. AYM Syntex Limited operates as a subsidiary of Mandawewala Enterprises Limited.
